verdict: The two-ETF accounting engine, saved results, custom-request adapter, bundled Python/data/seed integrity, JavaScript source flow, period/exposure analyses and financial report source wording pass independent offline review. No unresolved Blocker, Major, or Minor findings. Browser execution and remote deployment are checked separately by the parent task.

scope.custom_python_engine_cases: All-cash 0/1/2% under all three rules; 100% single-ETF edges; custom weights .3/.4/.3, capital 250000, cash yield .015, thresholds .075/.15; invalid inputs.
scope.excluded: Actual browser/Pyodide execution, rendered visual/interaction QA, CDN availability or network traffic inspection, remote deployment/publication, GitHub-secret access, and upstream data-vintage verification. Browser behavior is tested separately by the parent task.
scope.custom_ui_source_review: E in 0..200%, 0050 total-asset percentage in 0..min(E,200-E), leverage weight=(E-0050)/2, nonnegative residual cash; principal in wan; shared Python engine; same-condition A/B/C comparisons; embedded four-module/data/seed parity; source-level worker/result/download binding.

checks.evidence: All 40 discovered unit tests pass: 14 legacy, 15 portfolio, 5 period-analysis and 6 web-adapter tests. Command: python3 -B -m unittest discover -v.

checks.method: Enumerate piecewise funding regimes and trade directions to solve an affine post-cost NAV equation directly. This differs from the production bisection solver. Independently accrue cash across market-session intervals and payment events, then verify every saved daily account/exposure field, transaction, metric and manifest.

checks.evidence: Locked receivables and payment-day dividend cash are not spent; relative stock target weights are preserved when investable NAV is insufficient. Transactions sell before buying; complete rebalances absorb eligible paid pools. A hand-computable pay-date/quarter-boundary example preserves 360 cash that day and reinvests it into 0050 on the next session. Forty solver regimes agree within 1.17e-10 TWD.

All-cash NAV agrees with an analytic calendar-day compound-interest formula, with no trades and undefined Sharpe/Sortino represented as null. Both 100% single-ETF edges match legacy buy-and-hold NAV. Custom parameters agree with independent account reconstruction, and all eleven tested invalid inputs are rejected.

All 139776 combined daily exposure-export rows match their original saved books exactly. Nominal exposure equals 2 times actual 00631L weight plus actual 0050 weight; dividend receivables/cash contribute zero. Actual internal fund exposure remains unknown/empty.

All eight strategies retain identical pre-cutoff account states and trades when future prices after 2022-12-30 are changed by 13%. Threshold execution uses the next jointly executable opening session; one-price bars are valued but not filled.

checks.method: Independent index/anchor and cumulative-maximum formulas verify 624 calendar-year records, 240 fixed stages, 96 crisis events, CSV/JSON parity, and 12 synthetic cases. Crisis recovery scans beyond the event year, with 48 real events recovering in a later calendar year.

checks.evidence: Legacy backtest.py and test_backtest.py match the originally reviewed files byte for byte. The original review.json is preserved. Across the preserved legacy summaries, financial metrics match the original delivered summaries; public-snapshot metadata/config hashes can differ from the original private provenance snapshot. Six A variants independently match the corresponding preserved legacy 80% paths.

123 synthetic allocation-bound cases, invalid input rejection, real 160% fixed-result parity, 120/0/200% same-condition comparisons, exact embedded Python/JavaScript/data and precomputed seed matching, static JSON parameter handoff, result-bound context/downloads, pinned Pyodide version, JS syntax, no credential-bearing data fields/runtime credential reads, latest report content and isolated normalizer replay preserving all raw market/action fields.

limitations.description: Multipliers 2 and 1 define nominal market exposure from observed holdings, not measured daily derivatives leverage or beta inside the funds. Actual internal exposure cannot be certified and remains null.

Uses the same retrospective FinMind raw-price and verified corporate-action snapshot as the original review. Provider-adjusted validation remains unavailable and strict point-in-time vintage/publication timestamps remain unestablished.

Fractional units, fixed transaction charges and slippage, trade-date cash accounting, common executable openings, and ex-post rejection of one-price bars are modeling assumptions. They do not prove historical order fills or a conservative performance lower bound.

Calendar years, the five declared stages, and 2020/2022 crisis windows are descriptive retrospective summaries, not trading signals or proof of performance in other periods. Partial-year returns are not annualized; risk ratios retain the disclosed 252-session convention.

Cash yields are hypothetical effective annual rates. Receivables are valued at face value with no interest until paid; payment-day funds remain unavailable for investment until the next day. T+2 settlement restrictions, personal taxes, minimum fees and liquidity limits are not modeled.

Source and offline calculations cover representative custom engine/adapter boundaries and parameter validation. Actual browser/runtime behavior, network loading and visual rendering are outside this independent review and are tested separately by the parent task.

The calculator embeds its market snapshot and four Python modules but loads the pinned Pyodide 0.29.5 runtime from an external CDN. Source/data embedding does not make the initial runtime load network-independent or prove CDN availability.
